home.title: Ready for your theory test?
home.subtitle: Practice with realistic questions, mock exams and instant feedback — at your own pace.
home.shellNote: Your training dashboard is on its way. Your driving school will let you know when it opens.
home.signedOutNote: Your driving school will send you an invitation to get started.
home.inProgressTitle: Pick up where you left off
home.noQuestionsBody: Your driving school is still preparing the question bank. This page will open as soon as the first questions are approved.
home.mockExamLockedHint: A test mirrors the official theory test topic by topic. {topics} topic(s) still need more approved questions.
home.categoryTitle: How you are doing by category
home.categorySubtitle: From the tests you have sat — practice is not counted.
home.categoryNothingYet: Sit a test and your categories will show up here.
home.tileEmptyHint: No approved questions of this kind yet. Your school adds them in the admin panel.

errors.unauthenticated: You need to log in to continue.

errors.notFound: We could not find what you were looking for.

errors.internal: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again — if it keeps happening, contact your driving school.
errors.notFoundDescription: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.
errors.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
errors.forbiddenDescription: This page is for staff at your driving school. If you think this is a mistake, contact your instructor.
errors.unauthorizedDescription: This page is only available when you are logged in.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Continue where you left off.
login.totpSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.needInvite: New here? You need an invitation from your driving school.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: You were invited by {school}. Set a password to get started.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid anything easy to guess.
register.missingInviteBody: Registration is only possible with an invitation link from your driving school.
register.successBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick something you have not used before.
reset.successBody: You can now log in with your new password. Other devices were signed out.
reset.missingTokenBody: Reset links expire after one hour and can only be used once.

verify.title: Verifying your email
verify.successBody: Your account is ready. Log in to start practising.
verify.failedBody: Verification links expire after 24 hours and can only be used once.
verify.resentBody: If the address still needs verifying, a new link is on its way.

twoFactor.setupIntroAdmin: Admin accounts require an authenticator app. This takes about a minute.
twoFactor.setupIntro: Add a second step to your login with an authenticator app.
twoFactor.step1: 1. Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password …).
twoFactor.step2: 2. Scan this QR code, or enter the setup key manually.
twoFactor.step3: 3. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for setting up two-factor authentication
twoFactor.enabledBody: You will be asked for a code from your app each time you log in.

account.securitySubtitle: Password, two-factor authentication and the devices you are logged in on.
account.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
account.twoFactorOn: On — a code from your app is required at every login.
account.twoFactorOff: Off — your password alone gives access to your account.
account.twoFactorRequired: Required for admin accounts and cannot be turned off here.
account.sessionsSubtitle: Sign out anything you do not recognise.
account.sessionsEmpty: This is your only active session.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password combination did not work.
errors.emailNotVerified: Verify your email address first — check your inbox for the link.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is not active. Contact your driving school.
errors.totpRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
errors.totpInvalid: That code is not valid. Codes change every 30 seconds — try the current one.
errors.totpSetupRequired: Admin accounts must set up two-factor authentication before logging in.
errors.totpRequiredForAdmin: Two-factor authentication cannot be turned off for admin accounts.
errors.sessionExpired: That took too long. Please start again.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invitation link is not valid.
errors.inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask your driving school for a new one.
errors.inviteUsed: This invitation has already been used.
errors.inviteEmailMismatch: This invitation was issued to a different email address.
errors.emailAlreadyRegistered: An account already exists for this email. Log in instead.
errors.tokenInvalid: This link is not valid or has already been used.
errors.tokenExpired: This link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.passwordTooCommon: That password is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.passwordSameAsEmail: Your password cannot contain your email address.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.subtitle: Students can only register through an invitation from the school.
invites.listEmpty: No invitations yet. Create the first one above.
invites.csvHelp: One student per row with the columns email, firstName, lastName. Everyone gets a personal single-use invitation by email.

questions.title: Question bank
questions.subtitle: Every question, its state and where it came from.
questions.emptyBank: The question bank is empty. Create one, or import a file.
questions.bulkDone: {approved} done · {waiting} waiting for a second reviewer · {failed} could not be approved (of {total}).
questions.editorSubtitle: Both languages are required. Exactly one option can be correct.
questions.citationHint: Free text for now — the knowledge base turns these into checked links later.
questions.previewHint: Exactly what a student sees, at phone width.
questions.importHint: JSON or CSV. Everything arrives as a draft — import never approves.

errors.illegalTransition: That state change is not allowed from here.
errors.alreadyInStatus: The question is already in that state.
errors.systemOnlyTransition: Only the system sets this state, when the law behind a question changes.
errors.reasonRequired: Choose a reason before retiring a question.
errors.answerKeyUnknown: The correct answer is not one of the options.
errors.contentIncomplete: Both languages need a question and at least two options.
errors.expansionFailed: This question's placeholders could not be filled in.
errors.retiredNotEditable: Retired questions cannot be edited. Move it back to draft first.
errors.servedNotDeletable: This question has been used in a test, so it cannot be deleted. Retire it instead.
errors.optionFormat: Options must be written as key:text.
errors.importUnreadable: That file could not be read.
errors.approvedIsFrozen: Approved questions cannot be edited. Retire this one and approve a replacement.
errors.onlyApprovedReplaceable: Only an approved question can be replaced.
errors.selfApproval: You cannot approve your own question — it needs another reviewer.
errors.secondApproverNeeded: Recorded. An AI-written question needs a second reviewer before it goes live.
errors.imageRequired: An image or sign question must have a picture.

questions.replaceHint: The approved question stays exactly as it was asked; your correction becomes a new question.
questions.replaced: Replaced. The correction is a new draft.
questions.frozen: Approved and frozen — it can no longer be edited.
questions.bulkAwaitingSecond: AI-written questions need two different reviewers. Your approval is recorded — ask a colleague to approve the same set to publish them.
questions.selectAll: Select every question on this page
questions.bulkReviewHint: Filter to a state, select the page, and act on all of it at once. The quality checks and the two-reviewer rule still apply to every question.
questions.imageEmpty: No pictures yet. Upload one under Images, or seed the sign registry.
questions.imageRequired: Pick a picture — an image or sign question needs one.

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: Approve, edit or reject. The whole queue works from the keyboard.
review.shortcuts: A approve · E edit · R reject · J/K move
review.approved: Approved — it is now part of the question pool.
review.notePlaceholder: In your own words — what is wrong with this question?
review.noteHint: Your note is shown to the AI on the next generation run so it stops making this mistake.

reasons.AMBIGUOUS_DISTRACTOR: More than one answer could be right
reasons.CITATION_MISMATCH: The legal reference does not support it

review.recordedNeedsSecond: Your approval is recorded. This question needs {required} reviewers before it goes live.
review.subtitleOneSet: Reviewing one generated set. Approve, edit or reject — all from the keyboard.
review.factsUnverified: These questions were generated from a picture nobody confirmed. Check that what the question says is in the picture actually is — not just that it reads well.
review.imageAlt: The picture this question is about

sets.title: Question sets
sets.subtitle: Each set is one generation run — the unit you judge the AI on.
sets.empty: No sets yet. The AI pipeline creates them; you can also group questions by hand.
sets.aiSoon: Available once the AI pipeline is connected.

errors.alreadyInAnotherSet: Some of those questions already belong to another set.

sets.generateHint: Draws on the law in your knowledge base for the chosen topic. Everything arrives as a draft and still needs two reviewers before a student sees it.
sets.generated: {accepted} of {returned} kept ({rejected} failed the quality checks). They are drafts in a new set.

accuracy.title: AI accuracy
accuracy.subtitle: How often a human keeps what the AI wrote.
accuracy.empty: No reviewed AI questions yet — the numbers appear once you approve or reject some.
accuracy.noReasons: No rejections recorded in this period.

quality.title: Quality checks
quality.failed: This question did not pass the quality checks.
quality.stemMissing: The question text is missing in one language.
quality.explanationMissing: The explanation is missing in one language.
quality.tooFewOptions: A question needs at least three answer options.
quality.duplicateOptions: Two answer options say the same thing.
quality.bannedOption: Options like 'all of the above' make a question ambiguous to grade.
quality.keyMismatch: The option letters differ between the two languages.
quality.answerUnknown: The marked answer is not one of the options.
quality.citationMissing: Every question needs at least one legal reference.
quality.citationIncomplete: A legal reference is missing its source or section.
quality.placeholderLeft: An unfilled placeholder is still in the text.
quality.duplicateItem: A question with this text already exists.
quality.stemLong: The question text is unusually long.
quality.lengthTell: The correct answer is much longer than the others — students notice that.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.subtitle: Your own keys, added without a redeploy. Each task falls back down the list, so a spent free-tier quota does not stop question generation.
ai.addHint: The key is stored encrypted and never shown again — only the last four characters.
ai.label: Name
ai.baseUrlRequired: Required — it is what tells DeepSeek from Groq from a local model.
ai.baseUrlOptional: Leave empty to use the provider's official endpoint.
ai.apiKeyHint: Write-only. It leaves your browser once and is never sent back.
ai.noProviders: No providers yet. Add one above to start generating questions.
ai.routesHint: Lowest priority runs first. Add a second route for a task and it becomes the fallback.
ai.noRoutes: No routing yet — add one so the gateway knows which model to use.

security.title: Security policy
security.subtitle: Deployment-wide rules. Changes are recorded in the audit log with who made them.
security.requireAdminTwoFactor: Require two-factor authentication for admin accounts
security.requireAdminTwoFactorHint: When on, an admin must set up an authenticator app at first login and cannot turn it off. Instructors and students can always choose for themselves.
security.offWarning: With this off, an admin password on its own opens an account that approves exam questions and can read every student's record. Only turn it off if you have a specific reason.
security.pendingEnrolment: {count} admin account(s) have not set up two-factor yet — they will be asked at their next login.
security.aiApprovals: Reviewers needed for an AI-written question
security.aiApprovalsHint: How many different people must approve a question the AI wrote before students see it. A human-written question always needs one reviewer who is not its author.
security.aiApprovalsOneWarning: With one reviewer, a single mistaken approval is all that stands between an AI-written question and a student's exam. Reasonable for a one-instructor school — worth revisiting as the school grows.

languages.title: Languages
languages.subtitle: Add a language and the AI translates everything already in the bank. Students see it once it is finished.
languages.planReady: {count} unit(s) to translate — roughly ${cost}. Nothing has been sent to the AI yet.
languages.nothingToDo: Everything is already translated from the current source text.
languages.sliceNote: A slice at a time, so the page never hangs. Use pnpm i18n:translate for a whole language.
languages.runProgress: {completed} of {planned} translated · {flagged} held for review · {failed} failed.
languages.activeRun: A run for {locale} is in progress: {done} of {planned}.
languages.codeHint: BCP-47, e.g. es, ar, pt-BR. The site will serve it at /<code>.
languages.requiresApproval: A person must approve translations before students see them
languages.styleNotePlaceholder: Formal, second person, Modern Standard Arabic
languages.reviewSubtitle: The source on the left, the translation on the right. Anything a check flagged is at the top.
languages.editHint: Checked before saving, and remembered — your wording is reused wherever this text appears.

flags.KEY_MISMATCH: The answer options do not line up
flags.OPTION_COUNT: An option was added or lost
flags.ANSWER_KEY_LOST: The correct answer's option is missing
flags.ANSWER_PERMUTED: The options may have swapped meaning
flags.LENGTH_OUTLIER: Much longer or shorter than the source
flags.MODEL_FLAGGED: The AI said it could not translate this faithfully
flags.QA_UNAVAILABLE: The quality check could not run

errors.alreadyExists: That language has already been added.
errors.builtInExists: English and Norwegian are built in and cannot be added again.
errors.notComplete: This language is not fully translated yet, so students cannot see it.
errors.editRejected: That correction did not pass the checks — an option key, a number or a placeholder does not match the source.

languages.bulkApproveNote: Anything a check flagged is left alone — those need a person.
languages.bulkApproved: {approved} approved. {skipped} left for you because a check flagged them.
languages.autoApproveOn: On — clean translations go live as soon as they are written
languages.autoApproveOff: Off — a person approves each one before students see it
languages.autoApproveNote: Either way, anything a check flags waits for a person.

images.title: Images
images.subtitle: Photographs questions can be asked about. Uploads are private and served only to signed-in students.
images.attest: I confirm the school has the right to use these images.
images.attestRequired: Confirm the usage rights before uploading.
images.emptyBody: Add a traffic photograph here, then attach it to a question in the question editor.
images.duplicate: {count} looked like a duplicate of an image already in the library.
images.noQuestions: No questions use this image yet.
images.limits: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Up to {maxMb} MB each, {maxBatch} at a time.
images.contextSheet: What the AI read in this picture
images.noSheet: This picture has not been read yet.
images.addSign: Add a sign from the registry…
images.situation: What is happening in the picture
images.needsAttention: Worth a look — the readings disagreed here:
images.generateUnconfirmedHint: You can generate without confirming. The questions are then marked as built on unchecked facts, and whoever reviews them is checking the facts too.
images.generated: {count} question(s) drafted and sent to review.
images.answerDisputed: {count} were refused because the answer key could not be independently reproduced.

errors.noContextSheet: Read the picture before generating questions from it.

signs.title: Sign registry
signs.subtitle: The signs the sign test draws on. Provisional rows still need a person to check them.
signs.emptyBody: Run pnpm signs:extract, then pnpm signs:enrich, then pnpm db:seed-signs.

taskSets.title: Task sets
taskSets.subtitle: Partition the approved question bank into numbered sets. Nothing reaches a student until you publish it.
taskSets.rebuildBody: Re-partitions every approved question with a live variant. A set whose questions have not changed keeps its number, so a student's passed set stays the set they passed.
taskSets.emptyBody: Rebuild the sets to propose a first partition of the question bank.

quiz.answerLocked: Answer recorded — it cannot be changed.

errors.examPoolTooSmall: A full mock exam is not available yet — the school needs more approved questions to fill one.

errors.notAnsweredYet: This question has not been answered yet.

setup.title: Set up your test
setup.subtitle: Choose how closely this should match the real theory test.
setup.timeLimitOn: {minutes} minutes, the same as the official test.
setup.timeLimitOff: No clock — take as long as you need.
setup.guaranteeCounts: This test will count towards the pass guarantee.
setup.guaranteeNeedsAllCategories: This test will not count towards the pass guarantee. All categories must be enabled for it to count.

errors.noCategories: Choose at least one category to be tested on.

taskSets.poolNote: Each sitting draws {paper} questions from {pool}, so no two attempts are the same.
